prompt:

Header text verbatim: "fotografi". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "photography".
Scene: A student at a photography workspace comparing printed photos with a camera and adjusting a small studio light, clear art-study context.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "fotografi also names the art of photography.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon studerar fotografi.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
